brand_notes: Monitor Audio Apex A10: lifestyle/home-theatre compact in aluminium cabinet, sold singly ($849 each at Sky by Gramophone; ASR quoted $750 each Jan 2025), part of Apex range with A40 centre and AW12 sub. Aluminium cabinet, C-CAM drivers. ASR called it bright 'showroom tuned' and did not recommend (asr-monitor-audio-apex-a10). Official monitoraudio.com page 404'd to fetch; specs via Hifiverse. Bronze 50 7G (current Bronze generation, $849 pair US) has Hi-Fi News lab data showing 4.18 ohm min vs 8 ohm rating (hifinews-monitor-audio-bronze-50-7g).
takeaways: ASR Klippel: LW ±2.7 dB, f3 96 Hz, hor beamwidth 146 deg, pref 2.75/5.92; midrange dip, 1-2 kHz resonances, bright treble
Impedance plot reaches ~4 Ω at 58 Hz and ~3 Ω in treble (graph-read) vs 8 Ω rating: flagged effectively-4ohm
THD graph-read ~1.5% at 86 dB, ~5% at 96 dB near 100-150 Hz; 2 kHz third-order spike
ASR: could not recommend at the price; boost of upper bass via EQ fixes tonality
Sold singly; per-pair price doubled from $849 each; no professional critic reviews of current model ingested
conflicts: ASR impedance label 4 Ω @ 58 Hz vs curve falling to ~3 Ω above 10 kHz
Price: ASR $750 each vs $849 each retailer
